newsitem.title: UK: UK shares seen starting mixed after quiet Wall St.
newsitem.headline: UK shares seen starting mixed after quiet Wall St.

text.p: UK shares nudged lower at the start of business on Monday, dragged lower by a batch of heavyweight stocks going ex-dividend and with a mixed close on Wall Street on Friday weighing on sentiment.
The FTSE 100 index was down 8.9 points at 4,327.9 by 0840 GMT, with Barclays and Lloyds TSB -- both ex-dividend -- pulling the market lower.
Gaining stocks were in a slim majority, with 42 up and 37 down.
